description: Renovate for TryGhost/pro-helm-charts. Everything is review-required; nothing automerges.

packageRules.description: bjw-s common (Chart.yaml dependency). Renovate bumps the dependency and refreshes Chart.lock (helmUpdateSubChartArchives). values.schema.json embeds common's schema and must be regenerated by a human in the same PR; CI fails until it is.
prBodyNotes: 1. Run `scripts/regen.sh` and commit: it rebuilds `values.schema.json` from the new common schema and the rendered snapshots under `examples/rendered/`. CI fails until both match. Review the snapshot diff: it is exactly what changes in every app's manifests.

2. Bump `version` in `charts/k8s-app/Chart.yaml`. Renovate bumps **patch** for minor/patch common updates and does **not** bump for major updates: decide yourself whether k8s-app's public values API changed, and use a **major** k8s-app bump with migration notes if it did.
3. Read the upstream release notes and upgrade guide linked below.

packageRules.description: Minor/patch common updates: Renovate bumps k8s-app's patch version so the PR is releasable as-is (still review-required).
Major common updates: compatibility PR. No automatic chart version bump; a human picks the k8s-app version (usually major) and writes the migration notes.
Images in k8s-app values.yaml (helm-values manager: git-sync, mysql, curl...). No digest pinning: tags are rendered as image:tag and a digest suffix breaks the templates.
prBodyNotes: Bump `version` in `charts/k8s-app/Chart.yaml` (patch), run `scripts/regen.sh` and commit the updated snapshots before merging; CI enforces both. Renovate cannot do either for values.yaml changes.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: keep SHA pins, review-required, group minors/patches.
